0x19ab453c.notice: Runs the access-control + adapter module initializers. MUST be invoked via the diamond's `initialize` `_init` delegatecall.

params.admin: The address granted `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` (controls the remote-adapter setter).

natspec.notice: One-shot initializer for an OP Superchain `L2ToL2CrossDomainMessenger` gateway-adapter diamond — seeds AccessControl so the remote-adapter setter is admin-gated, and registers the ERC-7786 gateway-source interface via ERC-165. Unlike the {LayerZeroGatewayAdapterInit} / {CCIPGatewayAdapterInit} siblings there is NO endpoint/router ctor arg: the messenger is the fixed predeploy constant (`0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000023`). Delegatecalled by {Diamond.initialize} inside the initializing window (so it must NOT open its own pre/postInitializer; each `__*_init` guard passes because the window is already open). A first-class production deploy artifact.
